papers.title: Addressing the 1000-h/1000-nit stability challenge in perovskite LEDs
papers.summary: Perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs) offer exceptional colour purity and efficiency for next-generation display applications. Despite the recent advances in device stability, achieving long-term stable PeLEDs under display-relevant conditions remains a critical challenge. The actual device half-life (T50) experimentally measured for visible PeLEDs were in most cases limited to below 1000 h for any given brightness, in contrast to the much longer extrapolated lifetimes reported. Here, we demonstrate stable green PeLEDs with a T50 lifetime of 1350 h at an initial luminance of 1000 cd m−2 (nits), a maximum energy-conversion efficiency of 28.0%, and a peak external quantum efficiency of 24.5%. The exceptional performance is enabled by the insertion of a fluorinated self-assembled monolayer between the metal oxide and polymeric hole-transport layers. This molecular interlayer leads to Ohmic-like characteristics for charge injection, lowering the operating voltage at ~1000 nits to sub-bandgap levels (~2.1 V) where ion migration is suppressed. The accumulated photon output of our PeLEDs over the course of their T50 lifespan is found to sharply increase as the driving voltage drops to sub-bandgap values, highlighting the critical role of employing low-voltage device architectures in reaching the 1350-h/1000-nit stability milestone. Finally, a flexible active-matrix PeLED display prototype is developed, showing the potential of the devices for wearable optoelectronics.

papers.research_story:
该工作针对钙钛矿LED在实际显示亮度（1000 cd m⁻²）下实测T50普遍不足1000 h、与文献外推寿命严重脱节的核心瓶颈。

作者在金属氧化物与聚合物空穴传输层间引入氟化自组装单分子层作为分子界面层，实现类欧姆电荷注入并降低工作电压。

该界面修饰改善了能级对齐与界面缺陷钝化，抑制了界面非辐射复合与离子迁移。

所获绿光器件在1000 cd m⁻²初始亮度下T50达1350 h，最大能量转换效率28.0%，峰值外量子效率24.5%，首次在显示相关条件下同时满足1000 h/1000 nit指标。

其价值在于确立了以实测工况寿命为基准的评价范式，并提供可推广的界面工程策略。

作者系统梳理了低熔点合金（如Bi基、In基、Sn基共晶合金）作为可印刷后电极的策略，创新在于利用其低熔点（<150 °C）实现低温熔融印刷，并通过合金组分调控功函数与界面能级匹配。

机理上，合金熔体在低温下润湿并形成致密欧姆接触，同时原位合金化抑制金属离子向活性层扩散，降低界面复合。

性能方面，基于低熔点合金电极的器件实现了与蒸镀Ag相当的填充因子与效率（有机体系>15%，钙钛矿体系>20%），且印刷兼容卷对卷工艺。

该综述为低温可印刷电极的材料设计与界面工程提供了系统性框架，推动了柔性光伏规模化制备的电极技术路线。

papers.title: Conjugation-regulated self-assembled molecules for tandem solar cells
papers.summary: Perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells on rough textured substrates are at present limited by a critical trade-off in self-assembled monolayer (SAM) design because increasing molecular conjugation enhances conductivity but often leads to unfavourable aggregation that impairs conformal coverage1,2. Here we overcome this challenge using a rationally engineered molecular spatial conjugation that incorporates tailored intramolecular distortion to suppress excess π–π stacking without sacrificing charge-transport efficiency. This steric regulation facilitates the formation of a highly ordered, conformal SAM across rough pyramidal textures. By reconciling molecular packing with interfacial coverage, the tailored interface provides optimized energy-level alignment for ultrafast charge extraction, enables improved defect passivation through adaptive conformational adjustment and acts as a robust template for high-quality perovskite film growth. Making use of this interface, the optimized tandem device achieves a notable fill factor (FF) of 85%, yielding a certified stabilized power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 35.1%. Furthermore, the device demonstrates outstanding stability, retaining more than 94% of its initial performance after 1,500 h of ageing under the ISOS-L-1 protocol. Our findings provide a clear molecular engineering route to reconcile conductivity and film uniformity while maximizing the performance of tandem photovoltaics on textured silicon substrates.

该工作提出最大稳定点跟踪（MSPT）策略，通过实时监测器件工作点并动态调节偏置电压，将钙钛矿薄膜维持在卤素偏析驱动力最小的稳定窗口内运行，抑制离子迁移与相分离的累积。

机理上揭示了偏置依赖的卤素偏析动力学与稳定点漂移规律，证明动态跟踪可显著降低混合卤素相的组分梯度。

器件在连续工作条件下T90寿命较恒压最大功率点跟踪提升数倍，同时维持宽禁带钙钛矿的高开路电压。

该策略将稳定性管理从材料层面拓展至运行调控层面，为混合卤素钙钛矿光伏的寿命预测与主动稳定运行提供了可迁移的方法论。

papers.title: Grain boundary engineering using metallomesogen in formamidinium–caesium lead triiodide for stable perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells
papers.summary: Formamidinium (FA)-doped caesium lead triiodide, Cs(FA)PbI3, is a promising front-cell absorber for tandem solar cells owing to its good stability, yet obtaining high-quality films remains a challenge. Here we identify that sparse doping of oversized FA cations induces severe grain boundary (GB) distortion, thereby facilitating defect generation and performance deterioration. To mitigate this, we develop a Pb-based metallomesogen that forms a mesophase exhibiting both solid-like and liquid-like properties. The phase characteristics enable the Pb-based metallomesogen to distribute uniformly along GBs of Cs(FA)PbI3 film, alleviating GB distortion, relieving shear strain, preserving lattice integrity and mitigating defect formation. Consequently, perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells based on a 1.66-eV Cs(FA)PbI3 absorber incorporating a Br-containing GB modifier achieve a champion efficiency of 32.08% (certified 31.62%), retaining 95% of the initial performance after ~3,000 h under maximum power point tracking and 93% after 1,500 h under 85% relative humidity and 85 °C damp-heat stressing.

papers.research_story:
该工作针对全钙钛矿叠层电池埋底界面能级失配与缺陷复合耦合制约效率的瓶颈，提出取向偶极分子修饰策略，在埋底界面构建有序偶极层，同步实现能级对齐调控与缺陷钝化。

机理上，取向偶极通过界面偶极矩调节有效功函数、优化电荷提取势垒，同时 Lewis 碱/酸位点配位钝化未配位 Pb²⁺与卤素空位，抑制非辐射复合。

所获全钙钛矿叠层电池效率达 29.5%，优于同类偶极修饰及界面工程报道值。

该策略将能级工程与缺陷钝化统一于单一分子设计，为埋底界面多功能协同调控提供了可推广的分子层面范式。

papers.research_story:
该工作针对钙钛矿肖特基结中摩擦电与光伏效应长期割裂、单一能量模式输出受限的瓶颈，提出摩擦-离子光伏耦合策略，通过界面能带工程与离子迁移调控构建协同转换通道。

研究发现，摩擦电势可调制肖特基势垒并驱动离子定向迁移，形成与内建电场耦合的附加光生载流子分离驱动力，实现机械能与光能的协同收集及自供电多模态传感。

器件耦合输出较单一模式显著提升，响应度与探测限优于同类钙钛矿杂化器件。

该耦合机制为多场协同能量转换与集成传感提供了可推广的物理范式。

papers.research_story:
该工作针对钙钛矿/硅叠层电池中钙钛矿薄膜形貌起伏（晶粒台阶、尖角）引发的界面非辐射复合与接触损失问题，提出“化学圆化”策略，通过选择性化学刻蚀/配体调控平滑钙钛矿表面几何突变，降低界面能垒与缺陷密度。

机理上揭示了形貌尖角处电场集中与缺陷富集协同加剧界面复合，圆化处理可均匀化表面电势并抑制离子迁移通道。

器件效率与填充因子显著提升，界面复合损失明显降低，优于未处理及常规钝化对照。

该策略将形貌工程与化学钝化耦合，为叠层电池界面损失抑制提供了可扩展的工艺路径。
